string.name: name
string.value: Roly-Poly 10

string.name: n0
string.value: Am I working hard? Can't you tell just by looking?

string.name: n1
string.value: I want to get this done with and go home...!

string.name: d0
string.value: I used to work at the Toy Factory inside Ludibrium Clocktower, but I was sent here to fix the destroyed parts of Eos Tower. The number of monsters has steadily increased, though, making this job very difficult for myself and the other Roly-Polies.

string.name: d1
string.value: You're the one that took my picture the other day. Have you met up with all 10 of us Roly Polies? And you gave those pictures to #b#p2040015##k, right? Maybe our manager will be relieved enough to concentrate on his work after seeing those pictures.

string.name: func
string.value: Master of MiniGame

string.name: n0
string.value: If you want to know anything about minigames, then talk to me.

string.name: n1
string.value: You may try hard, but you'll never, ever beat me.

string.name: name
string.value: Manager Karl

string.name: n0
string.value: Those workers... Are they working hard even when I'm not around?

string.name: n1
string.value: Oh no, I forgot to bring my lunchbox to work today...

string.name: n2
string.value: I'm #p2040015#. There are many dangerous machines around, so please be careful.

string.name: d0
string.value: Hello there! I'm #b#p2040015##k, the guy in charge of the Toy Factory. Today's another one of those busy days...

string.name: d1
string.value: Oh! You're the one that met up with our Roly-Polies in Eos Tower for me! How can I help you? Huh? Haha, of course, I did not forget the lunch box my daughter made for me. I'm just waiting for lunch so I can eat it! I'll see you around!

string.name: func
string.value: Refining Expert

string.name: n0
string.value: Don't you want to make something? It's a piece of cake for me!

string.name: n1
string.value: Hmmm... You can gather some really fine materials here in Ludibrium.

string.name: name
string.value: Green Mesoranger

string.name: n0
string.value: As long as we're here, everything will be fine!

string.name: n1
string.value: Did we miss our takeoff...?

string.name: d0
string.value: I'm here on a very important mission given to me by the Omega Sector. It's very dangerous around here, so I suggest you run right now.

string.name: d1
string.value: The Roswell Field is prone to aliens appearances, so this place is under constant watch. The attack is still on, so I suggest you and others not get too comfortable here. I'll have to head back to the Sector for some more work, so I'll see you around!

string.name: name
string.value: Black Mesoranger

string.name: n0
string.value: Pink Mesoranger is ALWAYS late... we can't be at 100% strength unless all 5 of us are here.

string.name: n1
string.value: Nothing scares us when all 5 of us are together!

string.name: d0
string.value: Hello! I'm #b#p2040018##k, in charge of a mission to prevent the aliens from invading this place. It seems like they have been acting up more lately. It's very dangerous around here, so I suggest you run back to the Omega Sector for safety.

string.name: d1
string.value: You're the one that helped me get rid of #b#o4230116##k here at the Coolan Field. It feels good to find someone like you here at a place where dangerous aliens are a common sight. I'm still investigating the mastermind behind these aliens. I'm going up against yet another alien, so it's not easy...

string.name: n0

string.name: n1
string.value: Every once in a while comes a person whose face is a little hard to touch. You happen to be that person... Haha! How do you want it?
